rooms.description: A wall of frost blooms across cracked vault doors; your breath fogs in the dead air.
Frozen conveyor lines hang mid-motion, cargo locked under a decade of rime.
Something vast is sealed behind a wall of blue ice at the end of this hall.
Sublevel cryo-pods line the walls, most shattered, a few still faintly humming.
Ice has crept over an old command console; the screen beneath still glows.
A frostbitten market stall, goods long since freeze-dried solid.
